newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS says puts UGG on creditwatch list.
newsitem.headline: CBRS says puts UGG on creditwatch list.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service on Friday said has placed United Grain Growers Ltd on creditwatch list with developing implications.
The decision by the Montreal-based rating agency follows a hostile takeover bid for UGG from Alberta Wheat Pool and Manitoba Pool Elevators.
CBRS said it remains to be seen what the impact of the proposed takeover will be on UGG's capital structure and operations.

The agency noted that UGG's earnings and cash flow prospects are positive for 1997 given the anticipation of significantly improved grain shipping volumes due to the strong grain crop in 1996. CBRS added that benefits have already begun to show from the company's continued rationalization of grain elevators and efficiency improvements.
